# iximiuz-labs_play (Resource)

Manages an iximiuz Labs play session.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_play" "example" {
  playground = iximiuz-labs_playground.example.name

  # Required for community-authored playgrounds
  # safety_disclaimer_consent = true

  # Override init condition values
  # init_conditions = {
  #   runtime = "docker"
  # }
}

output "play_url" {
  value = iximiuz-labs_play.example.page_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `playground` (String) The playground name to instantiate.

### Optional

- `init_conditions` (Map of String) Init condition key=value pairs.
- `safety_disclaimer_consent` (Boolean) Consent for community content safety disclaimer.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO timestamp of when the play was created.
- `expires_in` (Number) Seconds until the play expires.
- `id` (String) Server-generated play ID.
- `page_url` (String) Web UI URL for the play.
- `status` (String) Current state of the play.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO timestamp of when the play was last updated.
